text: *1.Photo copy of passport (Photo page and China visa page)*2.ID photo with white background*3.Highest degree certificate*4.High school transcript*5.The Valid Report of Chinese or English Language Proficiency Tests. (For Chinese Medium: HSK4 is needed for one-semester program , HSK3 is needed for one-year program. For English Medium: IELTS≥6.0 or TOEFL≥85 or other language certificate recognized by BIT. English native speakers are exempted)*6.Personal statement (Download BIT International Student Personal Statement Template from https://isc.bit.edu.cn/→Resources→Download, and upload it in the application system after filling out)7.Applications under 18 must upload all materials required in Application Materials for Student under 18 from “Download” Zone as shown above8.Physical Examination Record for Foreigner (Please go to hospital for a physical examination as required in Physical Examination Record for Foreigner from “Download” Zone as shown above and upload it in the application system)9.Financial Guarantee Letter (The certificate of bank saving)10.Non-criminal Record (Issued by the local police station)11.Other documents
